embeds.title: v0.7.0 — The drains grow teeth (1/3)
embeds.description:
Season 4 rides in. Four new rats, an enemy wing that fights back smarter, and the gutters get a cook.

🍲 A tribute rides with this one: **Gutter Gourmand** carries Twilight-Runt's exact kit — a hearty buff at the start, thinned rations from wave 15 on — recostumed and dedicated to **Raabi**. Twilight-Runt retires into the name, same honour Draughtsman Moe pays RatMoe.

New to the roster:
🥋 **Squeak-Sensei** (5) — Trains every rat you summon as it arrives
🩸 **Grave-Leech** (6) — Bites back health on every clash it survives
🛡️ **Steel-Whisker** (6) — Armored, and its bristles cut back when hit
📜 **Gutter-Acolyte** (5) — Saps the whole enemy line's attack, every wave

New to the drains fighting back: an enchanter wing waits past wave 12 — **Muster-Herald** rallies the line, **Sluice-Warden** shields the front.
